patch.description:
Updates the configuration by overwriting the current context and the current source.

The configuration context is usually provided when creating a configuration and is used as input for reference characteristics on root item level. The context is always overwritten as a whole.
The configuration source is usually provided when creating a configuration and is overwritten as a whole. The source information cannot be deleted.
The context can be updated without changing the source (and vice versa), by not providing the source attribute or leaving the source data to be null. The same is true for the context: an empty list of context properties will delete the context, not providing the context or providing the context = null, will leave the context unchanged.

Single filtersourceApplication EQ 'cpq'

To retrieve stored configurations without sourcesourceApplication EQ NULL

cfg.ItemInput.description: Array of characteristics to be updated in the item. A prerequisite for the example to work is to have the configuration for product CPS_BURGER.

characteristics.description: List of characteristics belonging to the item

cfg.LockInput.description: Input structure consists of lock field.

locked.description: True means the configuration is locked against the changes. false removes the lock for the configuration.

id.description: Identifier of a nogood in the configuration

cfg.PatchConfigInput.description: Input structure consists of context and source fields. Context fields provide values for reference characteristics.

context.description: Configuration context parameters, provide values for reference characteristics

intervalType.description: Interval type of the characteristic to distinguish different types of domain elements. String/Symbolic characteristic values have either type 0 or 1. If it is numeric, '1': single value x == lower boundary, '2': [a,b) (right) half open interval, '3': [a,b] closed interval, '4': (a,b) open interval, '5': (a,b] (left) half open interval, '6': (-infinity, b), '7': (-infinity, b], '8': (a, +infinity), '9': [a, +infinity), '0': unconstrained domain

selectable.description: Specifies whether the value is selectable

valueHigh.description: Specifies the high value of an interval. The format is as described for valueLow

valueLow.description: Specifies value of single value characteristic and low value of an interval. For 'string' characteristics the string value is used, for date values the ISO format, float values are provided with the number of decimals as maintained for the characteristic

cfg.Source.description: Configuration source parameters, provide the source details of the stored configuration

application.description: Represents the application that owns the stored configuration or pricing document. For example: commerce, cpq, ACMEShop, DealerPortal, etc.

id.description: Uniquely identifies the source. Depending on the source type, it could be a transaction id, an item id, a product id, etc.

type.description: Represents the type of the source.

author.description: Reason code which explains the value selection

value.description: String value of the characteristic. For 'string' characteristics the string value is used, for date values the ISO format, float values are provided with the number of decimals as maintained for the characteristic.

cfg.ValueInput.description: Value input for the update configuration service call.

author.description: Author can be User or Default. If omitted, the author will be set to User. This field is ignored in AVC-Forwarding scenarios

selected.description: True means that the value is selected. Setting it as false will delete the already existing set value

cps.ErrorDetail.description: Represents a detailed information about an error.

field.description: A bean notation expression specifying the element in request data causing the error

value.description: Value of the element in request data causing the error

messageDetails.description: Descriptive typed error message includes the details of the error message.

typeId.description: Machine readable main error type. Will be null if status code has no different sub errors. 400 errors are often further detailed by a specific typeId. Whereas 404 errors refer to missing resources, leaving typeId null

area.description: The message area groups semantically related messages. The message area is mapped to a resource.

attributes.description: The attributes to the plain message. The order of attributes signals the position where they are meant to be entered in the plain message. The type of the attribute is one of {boolean, date, float, string}. Dates are provided with the short ISO format yyyy-mm-dd, floats are always provided with the correct scale. There is no difference made between decimal numbers and integers. Boolean are provided as either true or false.

context.description: The context provides additional information. Certain errors might be triggered from different application contexts. The context might also be used to do bulk operations in the message processing.

created.description: Timestamp (UTC) when the message was created

formattedMessage.description: The (English) message where the placeholder were replaced by the attributes. No further formatting was provided to boolean, date and floats.

id.description: Within the message area the message IDs are unique. A message ID identifies the message text within the message area - typically a resource file.

plainMessage.description: The message text in the plain message format: in English and with placeholders {1}, ...{n}

severity.description: The message severity. INFO, WARNING and ERROR are supported

transient.description: Typically, messages are persisted with the resources. Some messages are not persisted, because the intended request could not be processed. These messages are marked as being transient.

attribute.description: The attribute in string format that is inserted into a message's placeholder.

cps.Source.description: The source or owner of the stored configuration or pricing document that created it and is responsible of the life cycle.

application.description: Represents the application that owns the stored configuration or pricing document. For example: commerce, cpq, ACMEShop, DealerPortal, etc.

id.description: Uniquely identifies the source. Depending on the source type, it could be a transaction id, an item id, a product id, etc.

type.description: Represents the type of the source.

cps.VariantKeyFactor.description: VariantKeyFactor consists of variant condition key {key} and variant condition factor {factor}.

factor.description: Multiplier for the discount or surcharge determined for the variant condition key

ext.ConfigurationUserExitInput.description: Represents the input data structure (request body) of a generic Variant Configuration user exit.

type.description: Identifier of the extension type. Currently only variant functions (type = 'vfun') are supported.

ext.ConfigurationUserExitOutput.description: Represents the output data structure (response) of a generic CFG user exit.

type.description: Identifier of the user exit type

ext.KBHeaderInfo.description: Represents the header data of a knowledge base.

bomApplication.description: The application that was used during knowledge-base generation to determine the relevant bill of materials by its appropriate BOM Usage and Alternative BOM. E.g. SD01 for sales BOMs. Note: bomApplication is only part of the data model in most recent back-end releases with implemented BAdI KBSCHEMA_CURT.

changeDate.description: Date of the last knowledge-base's change in ISO8601. This is set to knowledge-base creation date for new versions.

plant.description: The plant that was used during knowledge-base generation to determine the relevant bill of materials. Note: Plant is only part of the data model in most recent back-end releases with implemented BAdI KBSCHEMA_CURT.

structureHash.description: Hash value of static product structure data contained in the knowledge base. It changes if products, classes, characteristics, values, bill of materials are updated.

type.description:
The type of the knowledge base indicates both the origin and the use of the knowledge-base runtime version. The following values are possible: variantConfiguration, solutionConfiguration.
Configurations that refer to knowledge bases of type variantConfiguration are processed with the Variant Configuration service.
Configurations that refer to knowledge bases of type solutionConfiguration must be processed with SAP Solution Sales Configuration.

validFromDate.description: Start date of the knowledge-base's validity in ISO8601

ext.KnowledgebaseKey.description: Represents the key structure for external identification of a knowledgebase.

kbName.description: Language neutral identifier of the knowledgebase.

logsys.description: Logical system of origin of the knowledgebase.

ext.VariantFunctionArgument.description: Represents an input or output argument of the function call and its value binding(s).

type.description: Data type of the parameter, one of string, float or date

values.description: List of stringified bindings of the argument in the internal (language independent) format.

items.description: List of stringified bindings of the argument in the internal (language independent) format.

ext.VariantFunctionInput.description: Represents the input data structure (request) of a variant function call.

fnArgs.description: List of function arguments. The Input arguments are distinguished from the Output arguments by their value bindings. Typically, a single value is provided for each input argument. Output argument's value bindings are left empty in the request.

id.description: Identifier of Variant function (language neutral name)

ext.VariantFunctionOutput.description: Represents the output data structure (response) of a variant function call.

fnArgs.description: List of variant function output arguments. The Output argumentâ€™s value bindings are set in the variant function implementation. Typically, a single value binding is provided for each output argument. If the variant function is called from a procedure for a multivalue characteristic, the output value binding can be a comma separated list of values. The list may not contain more output arguments than were provided in the request. Any â€˜extraâ€™ arguments will lead to an API violation error.

result.description: Result of the variant function, true or false.

fixedQuantity.description: Indicator 'item quantity is fixed' - i.e. not to be multiplied with parent item quantity

objectKey.description: The object may refer to a class or a product

quantity.description: Unit of quantity of the BOMItem

salesRelevant.description: Indicator 'item is visible in the sales order document'

kb.Characteristic.description: Represents a (global) characteristic describing a possible feature of a class or product.

additionalValues.description: List of possible values is not exclusive - free input is also possible

caseSensitive.description: Indicates whether the value is case sensitive

numberDecimals.description: Number of decimals, i.e. digits after the decimal separator (.) for numeric values

possibleValues.description: List of possible values with global value attributes

type.description:
The data type defines whether a characteristic value is a character string, a number, a date or refers to another item in the configuration.
Data typeDescription
stringcharacter string
floata number with decimals as defined for the characteristic
datedate values in ISO format yyyy-mm-dd
adtcharacteristics with 'abstract data type' refer to other items in the configuration

characteristicIDs.description: List of characteristicIDs belonging to the characteristic group in sorted order. The characteristic Id's that do not belong to any group are collected in a group with id as $general.

id.description: Identifier of the characteristic group. $general is the id used for the ungrouped characteristics. Thus, the '$general' group was not modelled explicitly

kb.CharacteristicReference.description: Represents the technical reference of a characteristic.

name.description: Technical reference of a characteristic in the form `<table name>-<field name>`, e.g. "VBAK-KUNNR"

writable.description:
The 'writable' flag describes the possible usage of the referenced table field from the perspective of the configuration service:
â€¢ If the writable flag is 'false', the configuration service treats the field as read-only: the value of the referenced field shall be provided by the calling application as input to the configuration context when creating a configuration.
e.g. VBAK-VKORG: sales organization is not writable
â€¢ If the writable flag is 'true' the value is calculated in the configuration service and the calling application should be prepared to take over and process the calculated value for the referenced field.
e.g. STPO-MENGE: item quantity is writable

kb.CharacteristicSpecific.description: Represents product or class specific attributes of a characteristic.

possibleValueSpecifics.description: List of product specific values and value attributes

readOnly.description: Indicates whether the characteristic is read-only or not

required.description: Indicates whether the characteristic is required or not

visible.description: Indicates whether the characteristic is read-only or not

possibleValues.description: List of translations for possible value. Only characteristics of string data type are translated.

kb.Class.description: Represents a (variant) class describing common characteristics of a family of different products.

kb.ClassTranslation.description: Represents a (variant) class describing translations of common characteristics of a family of different products.

kb.KBHeaderInfo.description: Represents the header data of a knowledge base.

bomApplication.description: The application that was used during knowledge-base generation to determine the relevant bill of materials by its appropriate BOM Usage and Alternative BOM. E.g. SD01 for sales BOMs. Note: bomApplication is only part of the data model in most recent back-end releases with implemented BAdI KBSCHEMA_CURT.

changeDate.description: Date of the last knowledge base's change in ISO8601. This is set to knowledge-base creation date for new versions

plant.description: The plant that was used during knowledge-base generation to determine the relevant bill of materials. Note: Plant is only part of the data model in most recent back-end releases with implemented BAdI KBSCHEMA_CURT.

structureHash.description: Hash value of static product structure data contained in the knowledge base. It changes if products, classes, characteristics, values, bill of materials are updated

type.description:
The type of the knowledge base indicates both the origin and the use of the knowledge-base runtime version.
Configurations that refer to knowledge bases of type variantConfiguration and advancedVariantConfiguration are processed with the Variant Configuration service.
Configurations that refer to knowledge bases of type solutionConfiguration must be processed with SAP Solution Sales Configuration.

validFromDate.description: Start date of the knowledge-base's validity in ISO8601

kb.Knowledgebase.description: Represents a collection of (closely related) master data describing the structure and the dependencies of one or several configurable products.

characteristics.description: List of characteristics used with classes and products in this knowledge base

classes.description: List of classes in the knowledge base

dependencies.description: List of dependencies in this knowledge base.

headerInfo.description: KB header info: ID, logsys, name, version, valid from date and build number

language.description: ISO format language. If the corresponding T002X entry is the default language for the ISO language code, only the ISO language code is returned. For example: 'en' is returned instead of 'en-US'. If no corresponding ISO code exists, the SAP language code (column LAISO in table T002) is returned instead.

products.description: List of products in the knowledge base

variantTables.description: List of tables contained in the knowledge base

logsys.description: Logical system of origin of the knowledgebase

name.description: Language neutral identifier of the knowledgebase

uploaded.description: Indicator if knowledge base was uploaded manually. Only returned if true, else omitted.

kb.KnowledgebaseMetrics.description: Represents a collection of metrics describing the knowledge base

bomItemsCount.description: Sum of all bill of material items.

classicCompilationTermsCount.description: Sum of all classic compilation terms.

constraintCompilationTermsCount.description: Sum of all constraint compilation terms.

descriptionsCount.description: Sum of all language dependent long description.

knowledgeBaseSizeDB.description: Estimated database memory consumption of the knowledge base based on HANA system tables information in bytes

knowledgebaseProfilesCount.description: Sum of all knowledge base profiles.

possibleValueNamesCount.description: Sum of all (global) characteristic value names of the characterstics.

possibleValueSpecificsCount.description: Sum of all product or class specific values of a characteristic.

possibleValuesCount.description: Sum of all (global) characteristic values of the characterstics.

symbolsCount.description: Sum of all characteristic values with type string

uiDesignsCount.description: Sum of all user interface designs.

variantTableSizeDB.description: Estimated database memory consumption of the variant tables in bytes, based on HANA system tables information

kb.KnowledgebaseTranslation.description:
Represents translations of a collection of master data entities which are by name: (configurable) products, classes, characteristics, characteristic groups, characteristic values and variant tables.
 General approach is that only entities with translations are listed. If no translation is available for an entity in the set of filtered languages, the entity is completely omitted. Empty translations are also omitted completely.

characteristics.description: List of characteristics translation used with classes and products in the knowledgebase

kb.ObjectKey.description: Key structure that identifies a product or class in the knowledgebase.

classType.description: Class type, for example, '300' for a variant class or '' for a material without class allocation

id.description: Language independent human-readable identifier of the product or class, for example, the material number

type.description: Type code for the product or class, for example, 'material', 'service' or 'class'

kb.PossibleValue.description: Represents a (global) characteristic value and its attributes.

description.description: Language dependent long description of characteristic value

name.description: Language dependent short description of characteristic value

valueHigh.description: Specifies the high value of an interval. The format is as described for valueLow

valueLow.description: Specifies value of single value characteristic and low value of an interval. For date values the ISO format is used, float values are provided with the number of decimals as maintained for the characteristic

kb.PossibleValueSpecific.description: Represents product or class specific attributes of a characteristic value.

intervalType.description: Interval type of the characteristic to distinguish different types of domain elements. String/Symbolic characteristic values have either type 0 or 1. If it is numeric, '1': single value x == lower boundary, '2': [a,b) (right) half open interval, '3': [a,b] closed interval, '4': (a,b) open interval, '5': (a,b] (left) half open interval, '6': (-infinity, b), '7': (-infinity, b], '8': (a, +infinity), '9'

valueHigh.description: Specifies the high value of an interval. The format is as described for valueLow

valueLow.description: Specifies value of single numeric value characteristic and low value of an interval. For date values the ISO format is used, float values are provided with the number of decimals as maintained for the characteristic

variantConditionKey.description: Variant condition key identifying a price surcharge for this value

kb.PossibleValueTranslation.description: Represents translations of (global) characteristic value and its attributes. Translations are maintained only for Symbolic types of values

translation.description: Translations for possible values of characteristics

kb.Product.description: Represents a product and its specific master data relevant for product configuration.

characteristicGroups.description: The default or general group (with id '$general') is sorted last for knowledgebases with 'type' 'advancedVariantConfiguration' and first for the knowledgebases of type 'variantConfiguration' and 'solutionConfiguration'. Only UI relevant groups are returned

characteristicSpecifics.description: List of product specific characteristics. Only characteristics which were inherited from classes of type 300 are considered. Characteristics from classes of type 200 are filtered.

configurable.description: Indicates whether the product is configurable

isRoot.description: Indicates whether the product could potentially be used as root item to create a configuration

multilevel.description: Indicates whether the Product has a bill of materials

kb.ProductByLanguage.description: Represents language, name, description, inspectionText and internalComment. If there is no value for name or description or inspectionText or internalComment for the language the respective parameter is omitted.

language.description: ISO format language. If the corresponding country code is set as default (according to table T002X), only the ISO language code is returned. For example: 'en' is returned instead of 'en-US'. If no corresponding ISO code exists, the SAP language code (column LAISO in table T002) is returned instead.

kb.ProductTranslation.description: Represents translation of product and of the characteristic groups.

characteristicGroups.description: List of translations for Characteristic group. General groups are not translated.

kb.Translation.description: Represents language, name and description. If there is no name or description for the language the respective parameter is omitted.

language.description: ISO format language. If the corresponding country code is set as default (according to table T002X), only the ISO language code is returned. For example: 'en' is returned instead of 'en-US'. If no corresponding ISO code exists, the SAP language code (column LAISO in table T002) is returned instead.

kb.VariantTableByLanguage.description: Name of a variant table in a certain language. If no name exists for a language, the respective parameters are omitted.

For example: 'en' is returned instead of 'en-US'. If no corresponding ISO code exists, the SAP language code (column LAISO in table T002) is returned instead.

id.description: Language-independent name of the variant table

caching.description: Flag indicating if results of a function provided by Local Extensions are cached

executable.description: Flag indicating if a function provided by Local Extensions is executable

id.description: ID of a function provided by Local Extensions

variantTableHeaders.description: Represents the header data of a variant table.

id.description: Identifier (Language-independent name) of the variant table

name.description: Short description of the variant table
